title: Renoprotective effects of DAPT against zymosan-induced acute kidney injury and senescence: Unraveling the role of toll like receptor 2 and Notch1 signaling pathways through an integrated in vivo and in silico analysis.
authors: Safwat, Maheera H; Abd El-Aleam, Rehab H; Rashad, Eman; El-Tanbouly, Dalia M; Ibrahim, Sherehan M; Fathy, Nevine
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨DAPT对酵母聚糖诱导急性肾损伤中TLR2和Notch信号通路的保护作用，核心为肾脏细胞衰老与凋亡，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助且非TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Renal tubular cell senescence driven by interaction of Notch with Toll like receptor (TLR) signaling is a principal mediator of acute kidney injury (AKI). The present study explored the crosstalk between TLR2 and Notch signaling in modulating senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) and apoptosis during Zymosan (Zym)-induced AKI in mice. DAPT, a potent gamma-secretase inhibitor, antagonizes the Notch signaling axis. Balb/c mice were used to evaluate the effects of Zym and DAPT over two timepoints (6 and 24 h); control groups: I and IV, AKI groups: II and V received Zym, and DAPT treated groups: III and VI received DAPT 1 h before Zym. Groups I, II, and III were euthanized after 6 h, while groups IV, V, and VI after 24 h. Almost all variations in renal tissues were evident 6 h after Zym injection and became more prominent at 24 h. DAPT reduced plasma creatinine, urea, and kidney injury molecule-1 as well as renal expression of TLR2, Notch1/Notch intracellular domain, and hairy and enhancer of split 1. DAPT lowered p21(Waf1/Cip1) and p16(INK4a) along with nuclear factor-kappaB, tumor necrosis factor-alpha, CCL2, and CXCL10 levels. DAPT modulated apoptotic signals, augmented Ki67 expression and exhibited improved renal histopathology. Molecular docking confirmed the interaction of DAPT with p21(Waf1/Cip1) and TLR2. ShinyGO-0.81 database was scrutinized for functional enrichment analysis and KEGG pathway mapping. Conclusively, the current study is the first to declare that DAPT could attenuate TLR2 activation-induced renal cellular senescence via inhibition of Notch signaling and its impact on TLR2 and p21(Waf1/Cip1).
abstract_zh: Notch与Toll样受体（TLR）信号相互作用驱动的肾小管细胞衰老是急性肾损伤（AKI）的主要介质。本研究探讨了TLR2与Notch信号在酵母聚糖（Zym）诱导的小鼠AKI中调节衰老相关分泌表型（SASP）和凋亡过程中的串扰。DAPT，一种强效的γ-分泌酶抑制剂，拮抗Notch信号轴。使用Balb/c小鼠评估Zym和DAPT在两个时间点（6小时和24小时）的效果；对照组：I和IV，AKI组：II和V接受Zym，DAPT处理组：III和VI在Zym前1小时接受DAPT。I、II和III组在6小时后处死，而IV、V和VI组在24小时后处死。肾组织中几乎所有变化在Zym注射后6小时即显现，并在24小时时更为显著。DAPT降低了血浆肌酐、尿素和肾损伤分子-1，以及肾脏中TLR2、Notch1/Notch胞内结构域和发状分裂增强子1的表达。DAPT降低了p21(Waf1/Cip1)和p16(INK4a)以及核因子-κB、肿瘤坏死因子-α、CCL2和CXCL10的水平。DAPT调节了凋亡信号，增强了Ki67表达，并表现出改善的肾组织病理学。分子对接确认了DAPT与p21(Waf1/Cip1)和TLR2的相互作用。使用ShinyGO-0.81数据库进行功能富集分析和KEGG通路映射。总之，本研究首次表明DAPT可通过抑制Notch信号及其对TLR2和p21(Waf1/Cip1)的影响，减轻TLR2激活诱导的肾细胞衰老。
